original_test_intent: Verify that unplugging one designated member from an approved isolated NVMe RAID1 produces the documented RAID-fail LED and correct degraded/member-failed controller and management evidence.
original_method: After destructive approval, build healthy RAID1 on two disposable mapped NVMe drives, have a qualified operator remove exactly one member, and correlate physical LED evidence with complete controller, OS, BMC and health state while deferring recovery.
manual_activity: User approves disposable RAID1 and recovery boundary; qualified operator removes one exact member and records LED; agent monitors without initiating recovery.
required_inputs: Two disposable NVMe identities and slot/controller map
RAID1 settings and fail-LED state/timing specification
Supported hot-remove procedure and qualified operator
Backup/OOB, abort thresholds and degraded-state duration
safety_requirements: Exclude boot/production/unknown media and verify both members before array creation
Begin from healthy initialized array with no background job
Remove only one mapped supported member and preserve complete logs
Stop on wrong member, uncontrolled rebuild, data/boot/controller/thermal/power/BMC error or recovery loss
Do not issue raw/Locate control, remove a second member, force online or auto-rebuild
agent_execution_scope: Capture healthy array/member/slot and LED baseline
Record removal timestamp and monitor authoritative controller state
Collect complete OS/BMC/health and operator LED evidence
Do not manipulate hardware, run recovery or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve targets, fault, LED and recovery contract
Provide operator and own array/data recovery
Review real failed-state evidence and decide verdict separately from recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Raw/Locate control neither creates a member failure nor proves degradation, and unsafe generic access may address the wrong component.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Create/verify isolated RAID1 through the approved controller workflow and capture authoritative degraded/member-failed state plus physical LED around one operator removal.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVMe RAID1 creation, one-member unplug, fail LED and source 15/8 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use immutable healthy and degraded snapshots around a real single-member fault, with recovery separately authorized.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact identity and data safeguards while rejecting indicator-only shortcuts.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation documents the real fault but cannot replace physical action or observation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Reinsertion can automatically start rebuild/copyback; stopping before recovery prevents uncontrolled writes.

project_override_considerations: If the intended physical media is HDD rather than the literal NVMe procedure, engineering must create/approve a separate variant; this review does not change target type.
expected_evidence: Critical approval and RAID-fail LED/fault procedure
Disposable member serial-slot-controller map and healthy RAID1 baseline
Physical LED photos/timing plus degraded/member-failed controller state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Procedure consistently specify NVMe RAID-fail behavior; the Storage-HDD grouping is broad labeling, while DeepSeek's method is incomplete.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Disposable targets, operator and recovery are supplyable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Preserves literal NVMe RAID1 fault coverage and requires a real controller-degraded state instead of raw/Locate LED control.
independent_technical_reasoning: A fail indicator must be traced to the controller recognizing the exact member loss and virtual disk degradation. Commanding an LED bypasses that health path, while reinsertion can mutate state again; therefore the fault, controller evidence and recovery boundary must remain distinct and identity-locked.
